character.name: Alex
dialogues: Welcome to my space... I hope you enjoy the journey.
This portfolio is a window into my professional and creative world.
I'm passionate about web development and solving complex problems.
Each project here represents hours of dedication and learning.
Ready to explore? Navigate using the side menu.

presentation.title: Presentation
presentation.text1: Jelou! I am Alex, an ecuadorean 20 year old computer engineer that loves playing around with tech stuff.
presentation.text2: Messing around with everything has always been something I love, tearing down everything in front of me, installing electronic devices, or soldering components to create stuff I like.
presentation.text3: I'm kind of lazy, but I do like to work on my own interests. I love what I'm studying.

list.name: VaultWave — Password Manager
list.description: Offline-first password manager in Flutter. AES-256 field encryption with keys derived through PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (100,000 iterations), plus optional hardware-key MFA combined via HKDF — the master password alone cannot decrypt the vault. No server, no account, no telemetry.

list.name: AKLight — Distributed Messaging
list.description: Kafka-inspired distributed messaging system written in C to monitor Docker containers. Producers fork child processes that collect CPU, memory, disk and network metrics and publish them through the broker.

list.name: Swift Analyzer
list.description: Lexer, parser and semantic analyzer for the Swift language, implemented in Python with PLY and exposed through a FastAPI web interface that visualizes every stage of the analysis.

list.name: Sudoku Solver with AI
list.description: Sudoku solver pairing a classic backtracking algorithm — visualized step by step — with a Keras neural network trained on 9 million puzzles. Desktop interface built in PyQt5.

playground.title: Playground
playground.intro: A cozy corner for the little things I build just because I want to. Grab a mug, poke around — everything here is meant to be played with.

folderView.title: My Apps
folderView.subtitle: Downloadable desktop & game builds — browse the folder like you're on my desktop.

arcade.title: Web Arcade
arcade.subtitle: Small browser games and toys, ready to play — no download needed.

apps.name: Warrior's Adventure
apps.description: A 2D adventure game about a warrior with a tragic ending.

snake.name: Snake
snake.description: The classic wall-and-tail dodger, reskinned in a warmer palette. Eat, grow, try not to bite yourself.

chess.name: Chess
chess.description: Full rules — castling, en passant, promotion. Play the CPU, share the screen with a friend, or open a room and play someone online in real time.

solitaire.name: Solitaire
solitaire.description: Klondike, draw one or three. Click a card to lift it, double-click to send it home, undo as much as you like.

sudoku.name: Sudoku
sudoku.description: A quiet little number puzzle for when you want to think about something that isn't work. Three difficulties, zero pressure.

2048.description: Slide, merge, repeat. Chase the 2048 tile without running out of room.

connectfour.name: Connect Four
connectfour.description: Drop, stack, and sneak a diagonal past the CPU. Three difficulties, or pass the mouse to someone else.

memory.name: Memory
memory.description: Flip two cards, hope they match, learn the board. Small desk-clutter icons and three grid sizes.

minesweeper.name: Minesweeper
minesweeper.description: Classic solo sweeping, or open a room and clear the board together with a friend in real time.
